simple.meaning: תְּוַהּ (tᵉvahh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to amaze , i.e. (reflex. by implication) take alarm.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 1 time across Daniel, beginning at Daniel 3:24. Its contexts include kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to תְּוַהּ (H8429).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
